items.note: Original page 1 clearly establishes opposing bends with 15.00 and 30.00 flange extents, overall projected 107.00 by 70.00, rounded flange corners and lower edge relief; supported=false and outline_exact=false are sound for the current basic flat template. However the note explicitly specifies 2mm non-magnetic stainless.
